data.narrative:
Helical Fusion is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Takaya Taguchi and Junichi Miyazawa that has raised $98M to date. The nuclear energy sector comprises a broad peer set of 11 total comparables (3 public, 8 private), including public names such as Oklo, Nano Nuclear Energy, and a small modular reactor ETF proxy, alongside established private peers including Valar Atomics, Helion, X-Energy, and Oklo's private precursor stages.

The valuation analysis is constrained by limited same-stage and adjacent-stage precedent. A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-universe datapoints (fewer than 3 comps meeting same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters). Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable method, applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $98M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $186M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $158M (low) to $214M (high), centered on $186M. This single-method triangulation carries inherent uncertainty: the nuclear energy sector remains early-stage and heterogeneous in technology approach and commercial maturity, limiting the predictive power of stage-based step-up assumptions. Capital requirements, regulatory timelines, and demonstration-stage risk remain material but unquantified drivers of appropriate valuation multiples within this sector.
